messages:
mike: Hey team — POC customer (AcmeRetail) reporting missing traceids in exported logs to Datadog. They see 429s when we forward logs through our drain.

jessica: Can you paste an example raw log line and the forwarder error? 429 sounds like rate limiting at our log ingest endpoint or theirs.

mike: Here's the error snippet they sent:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
{"error":"rate_limited","details":"ingest quota exceeded"}
```

mike: And a sample event:

```
level=info msg="request complete" request_id="" trace_id="" route=/v1/generate customer_id=acme
```

raj: Two things to check: 1) our log drain uses batching; if batch size or concurrency is low, backpressure can surface as 429s downstream. 2) missing trace_id probably because our forwarder strips x-trace-id when translating fields.

sean: I looked at the forwarding lambda — we map request_id -> dd.trace.id if present, otherwise leave empty. traceparent header is ignored right now.

jessica: Quick repro steps for them: enable debug on the drain -> set env LOG_FORWARDER_DEBUG=true and tail logs. Also send a single event with trace headers intact.

mike: I asked them to run this curl from an app node to simulate:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" \
  -H "x-request-id: test-123" \
  -d '{"msg":"hello"}' https://ingest.example.com/v1/logs
```

raj: If they see traceparent in the forwarder logs but not in the target, the issue is our mapping. I'll add traceparent -> trace_id translation and preserve x-request-id as dd.trace_id.

ops-bot: Routing rule updated: /v1/logs -> forwarder-prod (v3). Change by raj at 11:18 UTC

jessica: There's also a short-term mitigation: increase drain throughput by bumping concurrency env LOG_FORWARDER_MAX_CONNS=50. That should reduce 429s while we fix the header mapping.

mike: They asked about pricing impact if we increase concurrency — will this incur extra cost on their side?

raj: Extra throughput increases egress and our forwarding runtime usage. For POC we can enable a temporary limit for 48h and monitor. Suggest we log an estimate: ~+$40/day at current volumes.

sean: For the longer term, we should support tracecontext headers natively and expose a console checkbox: "Preserve trace headers" per route. I'll add to backlog and PR a config flag.

jessica: For now I sent them a checklist: enable debug, run curl with traceparent, increase concurrency config, and grant us a short window to patch mapping. Waiting on their confirm.

mike: Customer confirmed they can toggle debug and will run curl in 30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

jessica: keeping this thread pinned until resolved. I'll follow up after the curl run.

mike: Closing loop — after enabling debug they saw traceparent arrive, but still 429 intermittently. Bumped concurrency, 429s stopped. Raj's mapping patch landed in canary.

sean: Can we add a quick dashboard widget in Console under "Routes -> Observability" to show forwarder 429 rate? Low-effort, high-visibility.

jessica: Agreed. Filing quick task and assigning to eng-infra.

mike: Thanks team — POC moving forward. :rocket:
